note: Independent rejudgment upgrades RFC4271-9.2-3 (RFC 4271 Section 9.1.3 / 9.2) from partial to enforced after closing all four previously declared partial proof gaps. Eight tagged tests (6 positive, 2 negative) across rfc4271_egress_exclusion_withdraw_proof_test.go, rfc4271_selected_advertisement_test.go, and rfc4271_selected_exclusion_boundary_proof_test.go assert exact wire UPDATE withdrawals for previously advertised routes excluded from an Adj-RIB-Out while accepted siblings/controls remain announced: (1) ordinary in-process RIB/Loc-RIB selected export denial without lower-candidate promotion (TestRFC4271OrdinarySelectedExportDenialWithdraws), (2) framed forked JSON socket RPC publication across pkg/plugin/sdk/sdk_selected.go::Plugin.SelectRoutes with !HasBridge() for both policy exclusion and SelectedRouteAbsent (TestRFC4271FramedForkedSelectRoutesExclusionWithdrawsPriorRoute), (3) mixed SelectedRouteReceived/SelectedRouteOrigin exclusion transitions and accepted-route negative control (TestRFC4271SelectedMixedOriginExclusionWithdrawsPriorRoute, TestRFC4271SelectedExclusionAllowsAcceptedControl), (4) GR SelectedStale, LLGR SelectedLLGR, and Enhanced Route Refresh BoRR..EoRR replay exclusion (TestRFC4271SelectedRefreshAndStaleReplayExclusionWithdrawsPriorRoute), and (5) general and isolated rs=true route-server forwarding rails plus accepted-MED negative control (TestRFC4271ExportExclusionWithdrawsPreviouslyAdvertisedRoute, TestRFC4271RouteServerExportExclusionWithdrawsPreviouslyAdvertisedRoute, TestRFC4271AcceptedGenerationRemainsAnnounced). All 8 tagged units carry semantically genuine mutant discrimination records in rfc/discrimination/rfc4271/RFC4271-9.2-3.json across sdk_selected.go::SelectRoutes, forward_rs.go::reactorForwardRSSectionResult, reactor_api_forward.go::forwardUpdateSection, selected_flush.go::writeSelected, filter_ordered.go::runEgressPolicyChainASN4, and session_write.go::writeUpdateBody.
